findings.description: `continueRun` treats an instruction accompanied by `/agent retry` as a successful wait when the agent makes no commit, even though it has already advanced `lastAsk` past the instruction. If Qodo's existing review has no open findings, the next iteration marks the PR done without a new commit or a chance for the owner to act on the unfulfilled request.
findings.title: Owner requests can be marked done unfixed

findings.description: `continueRun` resets `pushedAt` for a retry with no new commits but leaves the previously processed Qodo review eligible because its commit still matches `s.head`. If the run stopped after the agent rejected that review's findings, the next loop sends those same findings to another agent run and consumes another review round instead of waiting for a new review.
findings.title: Retry replays rejected review findings

findings.description: `continueRun` sends a retry to `checkAndPush`, which rejects when `HEAD` equals the already-pushed `s.head` before it runs any tests. When the owner retries a stopped or completed run without new commits, the request consumes a comment round and returns the ticket to `agent-needs-help`; retry can work for an unpushed branch, such as one stopped during its first red proof.
findings.title: Retry after a push skips every check

findings.description: `continueRun` filters retry comments out of `writeReview` whenever any pending owner comment is an ordinary instruction, without executing their check request. If the owner posts both kinds before one poll, `lastAsk` consumes them all and the agent receives only the ordinary instruction.
findings.title: Mixed requests silently lose retry checks

findings.description: `testNames` joins all added lines in a commit before scanning, so `lastArgument` can finish a `check(` opened in one hunk using a string and closing parenthesis from an unrelated hunk or file. If that fabricated name matches a failing existing check, `proveRed` accepts its failure as proof for the new test.
findings.title: Unrelated edits can certify a red test

findings.description: `lastArgument` treats a closing parenthesis inside a JavaScript regular-expression literal as the end of a `check` call. For a valid new test such as `check(/foo\)/.test(value), 'a meaningful assertion')`, `testNames` misses the message and `proveRed` refuses its genuine assertion failure.
findings.title: Regex conditions hide failing new tests
